text.tspan: MANDATORY SAFETY DEVICES — Universal Design Constraints 3 and 4

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: SW1 (E-Stop, 22 mm latching mushroom, normally closed) and SW2 (ON/OFF rocker) are wired in
series in the battery positive line, ahead of U1. U1's on-board 78M05 derives the +5 V logic
rail from that same switched line, so opening either device de-energises the MCU, the sensor
array and the motors together — no path keeps logic alive after a stop.
SW1 latches: once struck, power cannot restore itself until an operator twists the head back out.
Robo Grand Prix compliance: there is no radio, no Wi-Fi and no Bluetooth anywhere on this
schematic. SW3 (ARM) is pressed before the car is released; after that the only human input
